assertions.assertion: Calls AddOAuth2Introspection with Authority set to 'https://auth.mycompany.com'
Sets ClientId to 'invoicing' and ClientSecret to 'invoicing_secret'
assertions.rationale: options.ClientId = "invoicing" and options.ClientSecret = "invoicing_secret" are both set.

assertions.assertion: Mentions or adds the Duende.AspNetCore.Authentication.OAuth2Introspection or Duende.IdentityServer.AccessTokenValidation package
assertions.rationale: Provides dotnet add package commands for both Duende.IdentityServer.AccessTokenValidation and Duende.AspNetCore.Authentication.OAuth2Introspection.

assertions.assertion: Warns that the ApiResource in IdentityServer must have ApiSecrets configured for introspection to work
assertions.rationale: A dedicated section states introspection only works if the ApiResource has an ApiSecrets entry, with example code adding new Secret("invoicing_secret".Sha256()).
